**NOT APPLICABLE – GDMT Criterion:**  
This criterion does not apply to ischemic cardiomyopathy.

**MET – Exclusions:**  
No exclusionary conditions documented.

**MISSING – Shared Decision-Making:**  
The medical record lacks documentation of a formal shared decision-making encounter using an evidence-based decision tool prior to the ICD order. The cardiology note (4/14/2025) documents heart failure status but does not reference SDM or discussion of ICD therapy.

---

**Required Information:**

Please submit documentation of a shared decision-making encounter that includes use of an evidence-based decision tool discussing ICD therapy with the patient. This must be completed before the order date or shortly thereafter.

Once received, we will complete our review.
